reuse.why: Reuses getScheduledAmount across posting, previews, forecasting and the API, but reimplements the existing getApproxNumberThreshold helper.

duplication.why: Removes several midpoint calculations but duplicates the tolerance formula and leaves budget/schedule-template.ts calculating schedule amounts independently.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts, with API serialization remaining in scheduleModel.

scope.why: All edits concern schedule amount policy, its consumers, the requested API field or focused tests.

maintainability.why: Centralization improves ownership, but duplicated tolerance policy, an independent budget calculation, stale comments and existing callers omitting the new operator weaken consistency.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts:getScheduledAmount inlines tolerance arithmetic instead of calling shared/rules.ts:getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated tolerance formula is directly recognizable arithmetic rather than a reshaped implementation.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount adds amountOp and an isapprox branch; server/budget/schedule-template.ts:createScheduleList retains its independent amount calculation.
